config.cluster_bootstrap: pigeonhole resampling of focal team IDs and both game IDs per transition
config.directional_independence_baseline: p(previous error > 0) * p(next error > 0) + p(previous error < 0) * p(next error < 0), among nonzero error pairs
config.preseason_rank_prior_classification: P(rank <= 10) >= 0.50 from the #200 preseason rank PMF; once per team-season per model arm
config.signed_error: observed team margin minus expected team margin
